text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The National Democratic Rally (RND) aspires to be an alternative political force to answer Algerian hopes in peace and development.
- RND's extraordinary congress confirms Abdelkader Bensalah as the party provisional leader until normal congress being held next year.
- The parliamentary elections dominate party leaders' activities as they strove to prepare for poll.
- Bensalah denounces some RND members for self-interest.
